nodes.label: Slider Content Block Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: 16x16 SVG icon representing a slider/card content block. Shows a white-bordered rectangle (card frame) with a blue image placeholder area (right side, blue fill #59F) containing a small white mountain/landscape thumbnail and a white circle (representing a photo), plus three grey horizontal lines on the left side representing text content. The overall design communicates a mixed-media card layout with image on right and text lines on left, used as the backend icon for the slider ContentElement in TYPO3.

nodes.label: Slider ContentElement (TYPO3 Content Block)
nodes.description: TYPO3 custom content block for a slider/carousel element, part of the sitepackage extension. Uses Splide carousel library. Icon visually distinguishes it in the TYPO3 backend content element selector.
